findings.comment: Zoning ordinance numbers are not referenced on the cover sheet. Only the zoning case number (C14-2011-0093) is shown. The applicable controlling ordinance (20120112-092) and secondary ordinance (19990225-070b) must be referenced on the cover sheet per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Zoning conditions and restrictions are not listed on the cover sheet. The project is subject to Residential Design Standards (Subchapter F) compatibility standards due to adjacency with SF-3 zoned property, including 2-story/30-foot height maximum within 25 feet of the SF-3 lot line and step-up schedule for structures beyond 25 feet. These restrictions must be noted on the cover sheet.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet Site Development Data table
findings.comment: Surveyor's company name, address, and telephone number are not shown on the cover sheet. The project team section lists Owner, Engineer, Architect, and Landscape Architect contact information, but no surveyor is listed. Surveyor information is required per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Required legal instruments are not comprehensively listed on the cover sheet. While a placeholder is provided for the IPM Restrictive Covenant document number, the cover sheet does not reference other recorded easements and maintenance instruments that encumber the property, including the City of Austin Drainage Easement (Instrument 2011021137) and the Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (Instrument 2010070731). A complete list of all restrictive covenants, maintenance agreements, easements, and other legal instruments required for site approval must be included per UCM 2.5.1(E).

Maintenance agreement document number or placeholder is not referenced on the cover sheet. The site plan notes indicate that the proposed stacked biofiltration/detention pond will be privately maintained and must be maintained per Drainage and Environmental Criteria Manual standards. A maintenance agreement is required for this feature. The cover sheet must include either the recorded document number (if executed) or a placeholder in the format: 'For [Feature] Maintenance Agreement, see agreement filed in document No. ______' with document number to be added upon recording.
